name: Koibito-tachi no Propose ~Itazura na Kiss wa Shiawase no Kagi~
original_name: 恋人たちのプロポーズ～イタズラなキスは幸せの鍵～
source:
You are working as a wedding planner and your boss puts you in charge of organizing three weddings. Which one will you choose to work on? 

There’s the wedding for the arrogant son of a rich family, a wedding for a dress designer who is also one of your suppliers, and the wedding for your ex-boyfriend who just can’t forget…

Is this sudden encounter a sign of destiny? Will you be able to overcome all the obstacles of love and get your own sweet proposal?!
translation:
你是一名婚礼策划师，你的老板让你负责组织三场婚礼。你会选择从事哪一项工作？

有傲慢的富家公子的婚礼，有服装设计师（也是你的供应商之一）的婚礼，还有你无法忘记的前男友的婚礼……

这突如其来的邂逅，难道是命运的预兆？你能克服一切爱情障碍，得到属于自己的甜蜜求婚吗？！
